# Advanced Dairy Diagnostic & Consulting, LLC (The Dairy Doctor)

## Who we are
Advanced Dairy Diagnostic & Consulting, LLC, doing business as The Dairy Doctor, is a mail-in veterinary diagnostic laboratory owned and operated by Dr. Glenn Pearson, DVM, in Frederic, Wisconsin. Founded in 1999 (originally as Dairy Pharm Services), the lab was the first BioPRYN affiliate lab east of the Rockies and has served dairy, beef, goat and sheep producers across all 48 contiguous United States since 1999.

## Services and pricing
BioPRYN blood pregnancy testing for cattle and bison costs $3.50 per test. BioPRYN blood pregnancy testing for goats and sheep costs $7.00 per test. BVD PI (persistent infection) testing, run from either a blood sample or an ear notch, costs $6.95 per animal, with volume discounts available for larger herds. Herd health consulting is also available, covering Johnes disease, Bovine Leukosis and Mycoplasma monitoring, Dairy Comp 305 records consulting, and biosecurity program design. New client discounts are available on all services; ask by phone or email.

## Location
362 310th Avenue, Frederic, WI 54837, United States. This address is both the business mailing address and the address customers ship blood and ear notch samples to.

Phone: (715) 653-2201. Fax: (715) 653-4301. Email: info@dairydoctor.com.

## How ordering works
There is no online store or checkout. Customers collect blood or ear notch samples on their own farm (a step-by-step tail-bleeding guide is published on the site), complete the PDF submission form that matches their species and test (separate forms exist for cattle/bison pregnancy testing, goat/sheep pregnancy testing, and BVD PI testing), package the samples with the completed form, and ship them by Priority Mail, FedEx or UPS timed to arrive no later than Wednesday. Results are typically reported back by fax or email within about 48 hours of the lab receiving the samples. Phone and email support are available throughout for questions about testing or forms.
